conviction_note: Small negative: a seasonally soft Q3 against a low ~$850-871K revenue bar that a flat-to-slightly-up print should clear, on a $0.80, ~6.0M-share microcap trading below its estimated cash. Against that, the last three prints were sold (-3.2%, -8.9%, -11.5%), the release will show roughly two quarters of cash with going-concern doubt, and a primary document (the chairman's RSU tranche) shows a financing of at least $6.5M is planned. The cash and financing overhang is largely in a price below cash, so p_up is 45, not lower. abs_move 10 reflects 111% realised vol (about 7% a day) and sub-$1 retail-driven tape. The findings sum (-1.2) and the scaled number (-1.0) agree.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue about $850K (Earnings Whispers preview, 2026-11-11, https://finviz.com/news/421186/icecure-heads-into-seasonally-soft-q3-needing-proof-that-choice-enrollment-and-us-installs-are-real) and about $871K (Benzinga consensus as relayed by search). These two roughly agree. Chartmill carries $1.064M (https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/ICCM/estimates), so the bar is partly disputed. EPS bar -$0.83 (Earnings Whispers, Benzinga, Brookline cut from -$0.56). Prior-year comp: Q3 2025 revenue $850K, implied by 9M 2025 $2.10M less H1 2025 $1.25M (https://ir.icecure-medical.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001213900-25-112380/ea026621901ex99-1_icecure.htm). Q1 and Q2 2026 were each about $0.9M. The company gives no guidance and called Q3 seasonally the weakest quarter. With one or two estimate sources and one dissent, every size is capped small.
positioning_check: No current short-interest figure was found. The last aggregator reading is about 111.3K shares short, 1.0 days to cover, settlement 2026-07-15 (Curved Trading, via search; https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/iccm/short-interest/). Against about 6.0M shares outstanding on 2026-11-01 (implied by the 5% threshold of 299,917 shares in the special-meeting proxy) that is under 2%, and stale. An undated search snippet from Curved Trading shows a borrow fee of 578.9% (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/iccm/), so the stock is hard to borrow. There is no options market, so no skew. Armistice Capital reported 4.99% at 2026-09-30 (13G/A filed 2026-11-16), a blocker-level holding typical of a warrant investor. Run-up: -23.8% over 20 days and -96% from the split-adjusted 52-week high. Tape: a +20% day on 727K shares on 2026-11-09 (Chinese patent PR) faded within three sessions.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 revenue should land near or slightly above the ~$850-871K consensus. The prior-year comp is $850K, before FDA clearance (Oct 2025). The US active install base went from 19 to more than 30 sites, H1 2026 US revenue was $608K (+64%), and Q1 and Q2 2026 were each about $0.9M. The CFO pre-flagged Q3 as the seasonally weakest quarter. My point estimate is about $0.85-0.95M, a print of roughly +3% against the bar, and 9M revenue of about $2.7M against $2.1M (+~28%).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 2026 revenue +45% (released 2026-08-12): the stock fell 11.5% (3.51 to 3.105). FY2025 with a record Q4, pre-announced in January (released 2026-03-17): -8.9% (21.90 to 19.95, split-adjusted). 9M 2025 (released 2025-11-19): -3.2%. Revenue growth has been sold on each of the last three prints.
findings.why_not_priced: The consensus is set to a flat year on year and the CFO's seasonal warning is public, so a flat print is the expectation. A modest beat would be visible only if the bar were higher, as Chartmill's $1.064M is. The beat is small and this name sells growth, so this is near zero.
findings.independence: The Q2 call (https://www.webull.com/news/15430266466092032) gives the US sites above 30 and the Q3-is-soft quote. The Earnings Whispers preview (https://finviz.com/news/421186/...) gives 19 sites in the prior quarter. Both are company-sourced, as is the H1 release.

findings.finding: The company did not pre-announce Q3. It pre-announced Q4 2025 (CEO letter, 2026-01-12: record Q4 of about $1.3M) and Q1 2026 (2026-04-21: US revenue up more than 30%), and in Q2 it published a mid-quarter install-base PR (+70%, 2026-06-17). Since August its releases have been clinical, regulatory and patent news (China NMPA, EUSOBI, ChoICE, a Chinese patent), with no sales metric.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The pre-announced quarters (FY2025 and Q1 2026) were still sold on the formal print (-8.9% in March 2026). There is no history of an un-pre-announced quarter surprising either way.
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody aggregates which quarters this company chose to pre-announce. If the market read the silence as soft, the bar would already sit below the prior-year comp; it sits at the comp. This is an inference from absence, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: The CEO letter of 2026-01-12 (https://www.prnewswire.com/il/news-releases/icecure-ceo-issues-letter-to-shareholders-reports-record-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-prosense-sales-302658394.html) and the IR news list (https://ir.icecure-medical.com/), which shows only clinical, patent and date releases since August.

findings.finding: The release will show about $8M of cash at 2026-09-30 and repeat the going-concern doubt. That is my estimate: $12.0M at 2026-06-30 less H1 operating burn of $8.15M per half, with no meaningful warrant cash because the $3.00 warrants are far out of the money. Primary documents show a raise is planned: the chairman's second RSU tranche vests only after a financing of at least $6.5M gross (proxy for the 2026-11-02 meeting, approved), and a reverse-split special meeting (5:1 to 40:1) is set for 2026-11-19. The stock was already reverse split 1:30 on 2026-06-04. Market cap is about $4.8M (about 6.0M shares at $0.80), below cash. The call will be asked about runway, and a raise of at least $6.5M is larger than the current market cap.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: March 2026: a $4.0M registered direct at $0.50 (pre-split) came within days of FY results; the stock went from about 21.90 to 18.84 (split-adjusted) over the week. June 2026: a $5.5M private placement at $3.00, priced at a premium. H1 cash and going-concern language accompanied the -11.5% print in August 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the stock is below estimated cash and down 74% since August. If the overhang were not priced, the stock would trade at or above cash. The unpriced piece is the size and timing of the raise, which is more than 100% of the market cap; the call or a same-day 6-K could pin it inside the window. What the money buys is the ChoICE study, the US sales team and burn, with no corroborated revenue ramp in a soft Q3, so the sign is negative (LESSONS rule 4).
findings.independence: The reverse-split special-meeting proxy (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1584371/000121390026114985/ea031043801ex99-2.htm, filed 2026-11-02) cites the Nasdaq $1 bid rule. The H1 figures (https://ir.icecure-medical.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/234/...) give cash and burn. These are separate documents on the same financing fact, filed once here.

findings.finding: ChoICE post-marketing study enrollment slipped. On the 2026-08-12 call management said the first patient would enroll within 3-4 weeks (before about Sept 1), with 80 patients by March 2027. The first two patients were enrolled only on 2026-10-20, about 7 weeks late, with the first treatment on 2026-10-27, so the 80-patient-by-March-2027 target is now at risk and will be asked on the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not identifiable. The ChoICE start PRs (Oct 20 and Oct 27) coincided with continued drift lower (1.08 on Oct 27 to 0.84 by Nov 2).
findings.why_not_priced: The delay is public and the Earnings Whispers preview flags it, so it is mostly priced. The only unpriced part is whether management cuts the 80-patient target on the call.
findings.independence: Q2 call guidance on timing (https://www.webull.com/news/15430266466092032). Earnings Whispers preview (https://finviz.com/news/421186/...).

findings.finding: The reaction function on this name's prints is negative. The last three releases with confirmed dates moved -3.2% (2025-11-19), -8.9% (2026-03-17) and -11.5% (2026-08-12) on the day, all on revenue-growth headlines, and the stock is in a 74% post-August decline with sentiment 'mildly negative' per the preview.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: These three are themselves the history. An earlier, unconfirmed-date H1 2025 print near 2025-08-12 was +3.4%.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a base rate, not news. It is filed because the baseline carries no reaction history at all (the FPI 6-K dates were not read), so the panel otherwise has no reaction function for this name.
findings.independence: Kalkine on the August reaction (https://kalkine.com/news/healthcare/icecure-medical-nasdaqiccm-falls-despite-first-half-revenue-growth). Shares the price source with the bar context.

findings.finding: The stock is hard to borrow and reacts violently to small positive headlines. Curved Trading shows a 578.9% borrow fee (undated snippet). A Chinese patent PR on 2026-11-09 produced +20% on 727K shares (6x average volume), and a June install-base PR produced about +280% intraday. The float is about 6.0M shares, so any positive line in the release or on the call (US site count, China first order, a Netherlands stocking order) can produce an outsized up-day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The +20% on Nov 9 faded to +7% within three sessions. The June spike faded from about $8 to about $3 by August.
findings.why_not_priced: Squeeze convexity is not priced into a point estimate. With no options market there is no skew to show it, but the 111% realised vol shows the tape behaves this way.
findings.independence: Yahoo daily bars for the Nov 9 volume (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/ICCM?range=2y&interval=1d). RTTNews on the June spike (https://www.rttnews.com/3660954/icecure-s-u-s-installed-base-surges-70-after-fda-clearance-stock-up-284.aspx).

findings.finding: There are new commercial channels the release or call can quantify for the first time. An exclusive Netherlands distribution agreement (2026-08-24, possibly with an initial stocking order in Q3) and China NMPA Class III approval of ProSense and its cryoprobes (2026-09-10, with no partner or launch timing disclosed yet) are both inside or just after Q3. A named China partner or a first order would be new.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The China approval PR on 2026-09-10 did not lift the stock for long, as it slid from about $3 to below $1 into November.
findings.why_not_priced: No partner, timing or order size has been disclosed, so there is nothing to price yet. If the market expected a material China order, the stock would not trade below cash. Sized small because the commercial path is unquantified and these are distributor channels.
findings.independence: The 6-K of 2026-08-24 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1584371/000121390026092807/ea0303119-6k_icecure.htm) covers the Netherlands. These are separate documents from the China approval.

outside_window.finding: Reverse-split special meeting on 2026-11-19 (record date Nov 4; 5:1 to 40:1 cumulative), the day after the window closes, needed for the Nasdaq $1 bid rule. Because of the 1:30 split in June 2026, a new bid deficiency is likely not eligible for a 180-day cure period. This is followed by the planned financing of at least $6.5M (the chairman RSU condition), which is more than the current market cap. Expected heavy dilution after the split.

baseline_tension: The baseline gives no option skew and no reaction history. A run-up of -23.8% over 20 days and -96% from the split-adjusted high says the financing and cash overhang is already heavily priced (market cap below estimated cash), which cuts against my negative lean and is why p_up is 45 and not lower.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (verified fact is not a predicted reaction; this name sells growth): revenue-beat finding +0.5 -> +0.3; print_vs_bar trimmed +5 -> +3 because the bar is partly disputed (rule 6)
Rule 5 (inference from absence sized small): no-pre-announcement finding -1.0 -> -0.5

Rule 4 (financing is a question): answered negative (going-concern doubt, no corroborated ramp in a soft Q3), but largely priced below cash, so -1.5 -> -1.0; the dated reverse-split and raise go to outside_window (rule 6)
Core step 4 (no double application): reaction-history finding -1.0 -> -0.5 because the revenue finding was already shrunk for the same reaction function
Rule 5 (proxy and unquantified distributor channel): Netherlands/China finding +0.5 -> +0.3
Rule 7 (hard-to-borrow, squeeze-prone): positioning +0.5 kept, and p_up moved 43 -> 45
